svg.aria-label: Three signs of missing visibility: a personal tracking spreadsheet, frequent where-does-this-stand questions, and no way to see an absent colleague’s work status.
svg.text: Three signs your workflow lacks visibility
If all three signs are true, the problem is not that employees are unfamiliar with the software.
The three signs are OKELAS’s suggestions: a discussion aid, not a certified methodology.
At least one employee keeps a personal spreadsheet to track work status, alongside the official software.
“Where does this stand?” appears frequently in email or internal chat even though the workflow is running.
When someone is on leave, colleagues cannot look up the status of their work without asking.
All three true: the system lacks the visibility to earn trust and replace manual tracking.
